prompt: In step 1 you rebuilt the first frame of an animated GIF as a three.js scene. Your step 1 page is below. The attached images are eight keyframes of the same GIF, in order, at these times from the loop start: image 1 at 0 ms, image 2 at 180 ms, image 3 at 340 ms, image 4 at 520 ms, image 5 at 680 ms, image 6 at 860 ms, image 7 at 1020 ms, image 8 at 1200 ms. The GIF loops every 1220 ms. Task (3D, animation): animate your step 1 scene so that render(t) matches the GIF's motion at those times. Start from your step 1 page; you may fix or improve it. The animation loops with a period of exactly 1220 ms, so render(t) and render(t + 1220) are identical, and render(0) must match the first keyframe. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Laughing yellow blob</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 216px; height: 216px; overflow: hidden; background: #ebebeb; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 216px; height: 216px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

// ---------- renderer / scene / camera ----------
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(216, 216);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xebebeb);

const CAM_Y = 1.53, CAM_D = 7.685;
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(16, 1, 0.5, 80);
camera.position.set(0, CAM_Y, CAM_D);
camera.lookAt(0, CAM_Y, 0);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0xd9c7a6, 1.95));
const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.55);
keyLight.position.set(2, 5, 6);
scene.add(keyLight);
const backLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.9);
backLight.position.set(-2.5, 4, -6);
scene.add(backLight);
const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff2dd, 0.4);
fillLight.position.set(-5, 1.5, 2);
scene.add(fillLight);

// ground + soft contact shadow
const ground = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(12, 64), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xf4f4f4 }));
ground.name = 'ground';
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
scene.add(ground);
const blobShadow = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.8, 40),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000, transparent: true, opacity: 0.1, depthWrite: false }));
blobShadow.name = 'contact-shadow';
blobShadow.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
blobShadow.position.set(0.1, 0.004, 0.05);
scene.add(blobShadow);

// ---------- materials / shared geometry ----------
const yellowMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf7c531, roughness: 0.6, metalness: 0 });
const creamMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf6e6c8, roughness: 0.7, metalness: 0 });
const greyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x7b7973, roughness: 0.7, metalness: 0 });
const toothMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0 });
const cavMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x4a1b15, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
const tongueMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x93403a });
const eyeMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x4d360f });

const sphereGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 36, 24);
const cylGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 20, 1);
const boxGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
const fingerGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.038, 0.07, 6, 12);

// ---------- character ----------
const character = new THREE.Group();
character.name = 'character-laughing-blob';
scene.add(character);

const torso = new THREE.Group();
torso.name = 'torso';
character.add(torso);

function ellipsoid(mat, name, parent) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(sphereGeo, mat);
  m.name = name;
  parent.add(m);
  return m;
}
const belly = ellipsoid(yellowMat, 'belly', torso);
const cream = ellipsoid(creamMat, 'belly-patch', torso);
const chest = ellipsoid(yellowMat, 'chest', torso);
const neck = ellipsoid(yellowMat, 'neck', torso);

// ----- head with a real mouth cavity -----
const HR = 0.33, LIP = 1.05, ZB = 0.42;
const NPHI = 44, NRING = 24, NIN = 8, NT = 7, TH = 0.2;

function gridIndex(rings) {
  const idx = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < rings; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < NPHI; j++) {
      const j2 = (j + 1) % NPHI;
      const a = i * NPHI + j, b = i * NPHI + j2, c = (i + 1) * NPHI + j, d = (i + 1) * NPHI + j2;
      idx.push(a, c, b, b, c, d);
    }
  }
  return idx;
}

const head = new THREE.Group();
head.name = 'head';
head.rotation.order = 'ZYX';
torso.add(head);

const skullGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
const skullPos = new Float32Array((NRING + 1) * NPHI * 3);
skullGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(skullPos, 3));
skullGeo.setIndex(gridIndex(NRING));
const skull = new THREE.Mesh(skullGeo, yellowMat);
skull.name = 'skull';
skull.frustumCulled = false;
head.add(skull);

const mouth = new THREE.Group();
mouth.name = 'mouth';
head.add(mouth);

const cavGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
const cavPos = new Float32Array((NIN + 1) * NPHI * 3);
cavGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(cavPos, 3));
cavGeo.setIndex(gridIndex(NIN));
const cavity = new THREE.Mesh(cavGeo, cavMat);
cavity.name = 'mouth-cavity';
cavity.frustumCulled = false;
mouth.add(cavity);

const tongue = new THREE.Mesh(sphereGeo, tongueMat);
tongue.name = 'tongue';
mouth.add(tongue);

const teethUpper = new THREE.Group();
teethUpper.name = 'teeth-upper';
mouth.add(teethUpper);
const teethLower = new THREE.Group();
teethLower.name = 'teeth-lower';
mouth.add(teethLower);
const upperTeeth = [], lowerTeeth = [];
for (let k = 0; k < NT; k++) {
  const tu = new THREE.Mesh(boxGeo, toothMat);
  tu.name = 'tooth';
  teethUpper.add(tu);
  upperTeeth.push(tu);
  const tl = new THREE.Mesh(boxGeo, toothMat);
  tl.name = 'tooth';
  teethLower.add(tl);
  lowerTeeth.push(tl);
}

// closed laughing eyes
const eyes = new THREE.Group();
eyes.name = 'eyes';
head.add(eyes);
function makeEye(sign) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = sign < 0 ? 'eye-left' : 'eye-right';
  const n = new THREE.Vector3(sign * 0.515, 0.68, 0.522).normalize();
  const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  up.addScaledVector(n, -up.dot(n)).normalize();
  const right = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(up, n);
  g.quaternion.setFromRotationMatrix(new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(right, up, n));
  g.position.copy(n).multiplyScalar(HR * 1.005);
  const arc = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.05, 0.014, 8, 16, Math.PI), eyeMat);
  arc.name = 'eyelid-arc';
  arc.rotation.z = -sign * 0.3;
  arc.position.y = -0.02;
  g.add(arc);
  eyes.add(g);
  return g;
}
makeEye(-1);
makeEye(1);

function updateHead(m) {
  const a = 0.66 - 0.08 * m, b = 0.36 + 0.21 * m, cy = -0.15 * m;
  const RL = HR * LIP;
  for (let j = 0; j < NPHI; j++) {
    const phi = j / NPHI * Math.PI * 2;
    const x = a * Math.cos(phi), y = cy + b * Math.sin(phi);
    const z = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.04, 1 - x * x - y * y));
    const thr = Math.acos(z), psi = Math.atan2(y, x);
    const cp = Math.cos(psi), sp = Math.sin(psi);
    for (let i = 0; i <= NRING; i++) {
      const s = Math.pow(i / NRING, 1.5);
      const th = thr + s * (Math.PI - thr);
      const e = (th - thr) / 0.14;
      const r = HR * (1 + (LIP - 1) * Math.exp(-e * e));
      const st = Math.sin(th);
      const o = (i * NPHI + j) * 3;
      skullPos[o] = r * st * cp;
      skullPos[o + 1] = r * st * sp;
      skullPos[o + 2] = r * Math.cos(th);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i <= NIN; i++) {
      const s = i / NIN * Math.PI / 2, c = Math.cos(s), sn = Math.sin(s);
      const o = (i * NPHI + j) * 3;
      cavPos[o] = RL * x * c;
      cavPos[o + 1] = RL * (cy + (y - cy) * c);
      cavPos[o + 2] = RL * (z + (ZB - z) * sn);
    }
  }
  skullGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
  skullGeo.computeVertexNormals();
  skullGeo.computeBoundingBox();
  skullGeo.computeBoundingSphere();
  cavGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
  cavGeo.computeBoundingBox();
  cavGeo.computeBoundingSphere();

  for (let k = 0; k < NT; k++) {
    const tt = -0.72 + 1.44 * k / (NT - 1);
    const x = a * tt, w = a * 1.44 / (NT - 1) * 0.86;
    const yr = b * Math.sqrt(1 - tt * tt);
    const yU = cy + yr, yL = cy - yr;
    const zU = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.04, 1 - x * x - yU * yU));
    const zL = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.04, 1 - x * x - yL * yL));
    upperTeeth[k].position.set(HR * x, HR * (yU - 0.04 - TH * 0.5), HR * (zU - 0.02));
    upperTeeth[k].scale.set(HR * w, HR * TH, HR * 0.1);
    lowerTeeth[k].position.set(HR * x, HR * (yL + 0.04 + TH * 0.45), HR * (zL - 0.02));
    lowerTeeth[k].scale.set(HR * w, HR * TH * 0.9, HR * 0.1);
  }
  tongue.position.set(0, HR * (cy - 0.45 * b), HR * 0.56);
  tongue.scale.set(HR * a * 0.62, HR * b * 0.38, HR * 0.17);
}

// ----- limbs -----
function makeArm(sign) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = sign < 0 ? 'arm-left' : 'arm-right';
  const shoulder = new THREE.Mesh(sphereGeo, yellowMat);
  shoulder.name = 'shoulder';
  shoulder.scale.setScalar(0.135);
  const upper = new THREE.Mesh(cylGeo, yellowMat);
  upper.name = 'upper-arm';
  const elbow = new THREE.Mesh(sphereGeo, yellowMat);
  elbow.name = 'elbow';
  elbow.scale.setScalar(0.122);
  const fore = new THREE.Mesh(cylGeo, yellowMat);
  fore.name = 'forearm';
  const hand = new THREE.Group();
  hand.name = sign < 0 ? 'hand-left' : 'hand-right';
  const palm = new THREE.Mesh(sphereGeo, greyMat);
  palm.name = 'palm';
  palm.scale.set(0.125, 0.09, 0.11);
  hand.add(palm);
  for (let f = -1; f <= 1; f++) {
    const fin = new THREE.Mesh(fingerGeo, greyMat);
    fin.name = 'finger';
    fin.position.set(f * 0.085, -0.07, 0.075);
    fin.rotation.set(-0.5, 0, f * 0.22);
    hand.add(fin);
  }
  hand.rotation.y = sign * 0.15;
  g.add(shoulder, upper, elbow, fore, hand);
  character.add(g);
  return { shoulder, upper, elbow, fore, hand, pole: new THREE.Vector3(sign * 0.15, -0.3, -1) };
}

function makeLeg(sign) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = sign < 0 ? 'leg-left' : 'leg-right';
  const thigh = new THREE.Mesh(cylGeo, yellowMat);
  thigh.name = 'thigh';
  const knee = new THREE.Mesh(sphereGeo, yellowMat);
  knee.name = 'knee';
  knee.scale.setScalar(0.18);
  const shin = new THREE.Mesh(cylGeo, yellowMat);
  shin.name = 'shin';
  const ankle = new THREE.Vector3(0.10 + sign * 0.40, 0.11, 0.12);
  const ank = new THREE.Mesh(sphereGeo, yellowMat);
  ank.name = 'ankle';
  ank.scale.setScalar(0.15);
  ank.position.copy(ankle);
  const foot = new THREE.Group();
  foot.name = sign < 0 ? 'foot-left' : 'foot-right';
  foot.position.set(ankle.x, 0, ankle.z);
  foot.rotation.y = sign * 0.3;
  const sole = new THREE.Mesh(sphereGeo, greyMat);
  sole.name = 'sole';
  sole.scale.set(0.16, 0.085, 0.24);
  sole.position.set(0, 0.088, 0.12);
  foot.add(sole);
  for (let f = -1; f <= 1; f++) {
    const toe = new THREE.Mesh(sphereGeo, greyMat);
    toe.name = 'toe';
    toe.scale.set(0.06, 0.055, 0.075);
    toe.position.set(f * 0.085, 0.058, 0.33 - Math.abs(f) * 0.03);
    foot.add(toe);
  }
  g.add(thigh, knee, shin, ank, foot);
  character.add(g);
  return { thigh, knee, shin, ankle };
}

const arms = [makeArm(-1), makeArm(1)];
const legs = [makeLeg(-1), makeLeg(1)];

// ---------- helpers ----------
const UP = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
const _d = new THREE.Vector3(), _dir = new THREE.Vector3(), _perp = new THREE.Vector3();

function setSeg(mesh, a, b, r) {
  _d.subVectors(b, a);
  const len = Math.max(_d.length(), 1e-4);
  _d.multiplyScalar(1 / len);
  mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(UP, _d);
  mesh.position.addVectors(a, b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
  mesh.scale.set(r, len, r);
}

function solveElbow(S, T, L1, L2, pole, out) {
  _dir.subVectors(T, S);
  const dist = Math.max(_dir.length(), 1e-4);
  _dir.multiplyScalar(1 / dist);
  if (dist >= (L1 + L2) * 0.998) {
    return out.copy(S).addScaledVector(_dir, dist * L1 / (L1 + L2));
  }
  const a = (L1 * L1 - L2 * L2 + dist * dist) / (2 * dist);
  const h = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, L1 * L1 - a * a));
  _perp.copy(pole).addScaledVector(_dir, -pole.dot(_dir)).normalize();
  return out.copy(S).addScaledVector(_dir, a).addScaledVector(_perp, h);
}

// screen pixel (216 px frame) at depth z -> world position
function scr(px, py, z, out) {
  const k = (CAM_D - z) / CAM_D;
  return out.set((px - 108) / 100 * k, CAM_Y + (108 - py) / 100 * k, z);
}

// ---------- keyframes ----------
const PERIOD = 1220;
const KT = [0, 180, 340, 520, 680, 860, 1020, 1200];
// bellyX, bellyY, headX, headY, headPitchUp(deg), headRoll(deg), headYaw(deg), mouthOpen,
// leftHandX, leftHandY, rightHandX, rightHandY   (positions in reference pixels)
const KF = [
  [112, 133, 120,  46,   0, -10,  3, 1.00, 88, 182, 158, 185],
  [115, 178, 111,  92,  -2,  -3,  0, 0.10, 70, 188, 157, 190],
  [111, 132, 119,  45,  26,  -4,  3, 1.00, 80, 182, 155, 185],
  [111, 133, 101,  52,  -3,   8, -2, 0.90, 82, 182, 155, 185],
  [117, 186,  98, 107, -14,   9,  2, 0.25, 68, 190, 152, 188],
  [111, 135, 112,  51,  32,   2, -3, 0.95, 75, 185, 155, 185],
  [112, 138,  97,  57, -12,   8, -6, 0.95, 88, 180, 158, 185],
  [118, 178,  98, 102, -15,  10,  2, 0.30, 68, 186, 150, 188]
];
const NV = 12;
const cur = new Float64Array(NV);

function sample(t) {
  let tm = t % PERIOD;
  if (tm < 0) tm += PERIOD;
  let i = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < KT.length; k++) { if (tm >= KT[k]) i = k; }
  const j = (i + 1) % KT.length;
  const t0 = KT[i], t1 = (j === 0) ? PERIOD : KT[j];
  let u = (tm - t0) / (t1 - t0);
  u = u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
  const A = KF[i], Bk = KF[j];
  for (let n = 0; n < NV; n++) cur[n] = A[n] + (Bk[n] - A[n]) * u;
}

// ---------- pose ----------
const DEG = Math.PI / 180;
const vB = new THREE.Vector3(), vH = new THREE.Vector3();
const vS = new THREE.Vector3(), vE = new THREE.Vector3(), vHand = new THREE.Vector3();
const vW = new THREE.Vector3(), vHip = new THREE.Vector3(), vK = new THREE.Vector3();

function pose(t) {
  sample(t);
  scr(cur[0], cur[1], 0, vB);
  scr(cur[2], cur[3], 0.10, vH);
  const dx = vH.x - vB.x, dy = vH.y - vB.y;
  const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const sy = Math.min(1.15, Math.max(0.7, len / 0.87));
  const lean = -0.45 * Math.atan2(dx, dy);
  const cl = Math.cos(lean), sl = Math.sin(lean);
  const q = Math.min(1.2, Math.max(0, (1.28 - vB.y) / 0.5));

  const tx = vB.x + sl * 0.6 * sy, ty = vB.y - cl * 0.6 * sy;
  torso.position.set(tx, ty, 0);
  torso.rotation.set(0, 0, lean);

  // head centre expressed in torso space
  const hx = vH.x - tx, hy = vH.y - ty;
  const lx = cl * hx + sl * hy, ly = -sl * hx + cl * hy;

  const wx = 1 + 0.08 * q, wz = 1 + 0.05 * q;
  belly.position.set(0, 0.6 * sy, 0);
  belly.scale.set(0.39 * wx, 0.64 * sy, 0.36 * wz);
  cream.position.set(0, 0.6 * sy, 0.08);
  cream.scale.set(0.358 * wx, 0.517 * sy, 0.31 * wz);
  chest.position.set(lx * 0.2, 0.98 * sy, -0.02);
  chest.scale.set(0.42 + 0.13 * q, 0.33, 0.29);
  neck.position.set(lx * 0.6, 1.26 * sy, -0.04);
  neck.scale.set(0.32 + 0.06 * q, 0.22, 0.20);

  head.position.set(lx, ly, 0.10);
  head.rotation.set(-cur[4] * DEG, cur[6] * DEG, cur[5] * DEG - lean);
  updateHead(cur[7]);

  torso.updateMatrix();

  for (let s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
    const sign = s === 0 ? -1 : 1;
    const arm = arms[s], leg = legs[s];
    const hpx = s === 0 ? cur[8] : cur[10];
    const hpy = s === 0 ? cur[9] : cur[11];

    vS.set(sign * (0.36 + 0.12 * q) + lx * 0.25, (1.07 + 0.08 * q) * sy, 0.03).applyMatrix4(torso.matrix);
    scr(hpx, hpy, 0.38, vHand);
    solveElbow(vS, vHand, 0.53, 0.53, arm.pole, vE);
    arm.shoulder.position.copy(vS);
    arm.elbow.position.copy(vE);
    setSeg(arm.upper, vS, vE, 0.125);
    vW.subVectors(vE, vHand).normalize().multiplyScalar(0.05).add(vHand);
    setSeg(arm.fore, vE, vW, 0.108);
    arm.hand.position.copy(vHand);

    vHip.set(sign * 0.24, 0.12, -0.06).applyMatrix4(torso.matrix);
    vK.set(vHand.x, vHand.y - 0.16, vHand.z - 0.10);
    leg.knee.position.copy(vK);
    setSeg(leg.thigh, vHip, vK, 0.18);
    setSeg(leg.shin, vK, leg.ankle, 0.15);
  }
}

function render(t) {
  pose(Number(t) || 0);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

render(0);

window.nwb = {
  scene,
  renderer,
  cameras: { ref: camera },
  characters: [character],
  render,
  ready: true
};
</script>
</body>
</html>
